recipe.visualDefinition: A profile portrait of a man rendered in vibrant purple and violet hues, featuring a cosmic galaxy texture within the hair and a lush base of red and yellow flowers, set against a flat teal background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant purple skin tones contrasting against a flat teal background
Cosmic nebula and star field integrated into the hair silhouette
Organic floral arrangement acting as a base for the neck and shoulders
Fluid, visible brushstrokes defining facial structure and highlights
coreInvariants: Galaxy texture restricted to the hair area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile head centered horizontally, slightly shifted right, occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eye and cheekbone area, highlighted with brighter purples and whites.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the facial profile, moves upward to the galaxy hair, and flows down to the floral base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive teal negative space surrounding the head, particularly on the left side.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; dark values in the beard and hair contrast with bright white highlights on the nose and forehead.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weight with thick downstrokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone script for organic contrast against the painted subject.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the painterly, handmade feel of the artwork.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a painterly profile portrait of a man with deep purple skin tones. The hair should contain a detailed galaxy nebula with stars. The base of the neck should transition into a cluster of vibrant red and yellow roses. The background is a solid, flat teal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom script lettering in the top left corner at a slight upward angle. The text should be off-white with a fluid, hand-drawn brush quality.

verificationChecks: Is the skin tone distinctly purple?
Is the galaxy texture contained within the hair?
Are the flowers at the base vibrant and painterly?
Is the text angled upward in the top left?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of galaxy into hair

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the teal background is flat and lacks gradient.
Verify the brushwork looks hand-applied rather than filtered.
Check that the purple skin has a range of values from deep violet to lavender.
Confirm the text is legible despite the script style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile Portrait + [Skin Color: Purple] + [Hair Texture: Galaxy] + [Base Element: Flowers] + [Background: Flat Teal] + [Text: Angled Script]
